studies.context_id: 944046|Dietary protein intake|Kidney and renal pelvis cancer
studies.Study: Armstrong B et al. (1976) [PMID: 944046] — estimate 1 · NA
studies.Reference: A retrospective study of renal cancer with special reference to coffee and animal protein consumption.
studies.Title: A retrospective study of renal cancer with special reference to coffee and animal protein consumption.
studies.Authors: Armstrong B, Garrod A, Doll R
studies.Population: Patients diagnosed with renal cancer in the Oxford Regional Hospital Board area and selected London hospitals

sample_size.excerpt: Interviews were obtained with 106 patients with adenocarcinoma of the renal parenchyma, 33 patients with carcinoma of the renal pelvis and 139 individually matched control patients.
sample_size.location: Results, Patients' characteristics, paragraph 1; total_n derived from reported group counts 106 + 33 + 139 = 278

cases.excerpt: RESULTS Patients' characteristics A total of 139 pairs of patients with and without renal cancer were interviewed.

design.excerpt: For each cancer patient, a control patient was selected at random, matched according to the following criteria: (1) same sex; (2) within the same 5-year age group; and (3)' having had a surgical operation in the same hospital

timing.excerpt: Notification was obtained of all patients diagnosed between 1 January 1972, and 31 December 1974, as suffering from renal cancer

continent.excerpt: Front the Department of the Regius Professor of Medicine and DHSS Cancer Epidemiology and Clinical Trials Unit, Radcliffe Infirmary, Oxford OX2 6HE

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Each cancer and each control patient was interviewed by a research assistant who was also a trained nurse.

gender.excerpt: Data on the age and sex of the renal cancer patients are shown in Table II.

smoking_status.excerpt: Renal cancer and control patients are compared with respect to tobacco use in Tables Vl and VI.
